scenario_title: Regression behind a skipped load suite
title: Latency and timeouts on api-gateway

detection.alert: api-gateway: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-07-14 19:37-23:57: api-gateway: 246 of 349 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-07-14 19:37 and 2026-07-14 23:57 UTC (peak error ratio 0.91 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 28.592 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} introduced a regression that only the skipped ppd load suite would have caught.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) changes the condition / constant shown in the diff.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; revert {file}:{line}. Make the ppd load suite mandatory.

rca.macro: Deploy v3.35.0 of cloud-api introduced a regression that only the skipped ppd load suite would have caught.
rca.micro: cloud-api/nova/image/cache.py:52 (ImageCacheManager.verify_base_images) changes the condition / constant shown in the diff.
rca.remediation: Roll back cloud-api v3.35.0 -> v3.34.0; revert cloud-api/nova/image/cache.py:52. Make the ppd load suite mandatory.

action_items: Make the ppd load test suite mandatory before prod.
Add a regression test covering ImageCacheManager.verify_base_images (cloud-api/nova/image/cache.py).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=cloud-api`.
